23:2: They are those who feel reverent awe in their salah.
23:3: And those who turn away from vain things.
23:4: And they are those who do their zakat.
23:5: And those who guard their chastity,
23:6: Except for their spouses or the concubines whom their right hands possess, for indeed they are not blameworthy.
23:7: Whoever seeks beyond this, then it is they who are the transgressors.
23:8: And those who observe their trusts and their covenants.
23:9: And they are those who guard their salahs.
23:10: It is they, they are the inheritors.
23:11: They are those who inherit Firdaus; they will abide therein forever.
23:12: And by oath, We created man from an essence of clay.
23:13: Then We placed him as a drop of semen in a firm resting place.
23:14: Then We made the nutfah an alaqah, We made the alaqah a mudghah, We made the mudghah bones, We clothed the bones with flesh, then We developed him into another creation; so blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
23:15: Then undoubtedly, after this, you are surely those who will die.
23:16: Then undoubtedly you will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection.
23:17: And by oath, We created seven layers above you, and We were not unaware of creation.
23:18: And We sent down water from the sky in a measure and lodged it in the earth, and undoubtedly We are surely capable of taking it away.
23:19: Thus with it We brought into being for you gardens of date palms and vineyards; there are many fruits in them for you, and from them you eat.
23:20: And a tree that emerges from Mount Sinai, which produces oil and a condiment for those who eat.
23:21: Undoubtedly for you in the cattle there is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are many benefits, and from them you eat.
23:22: Upon them and upon the ships you are carried.
23:23: And by oath, We sent Noah to his people, and he said: O my people! Worship Allah. There is no deity for you other than Him. Will you not still fear Him?
23:24: The notables who disbelieved from his people said: This is nothing but a human being like you, he wants to gain superiority over you. If Allah had willed, He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our earlier forefathers.
23:25: He is only a man in whom is madness, so wait for him for a time.
23:26: He said: My Rabb, help me because they have denied me.
23:27: Thereupon We revealed to him: Make the ship under Our observation and with Our revelation. When Our command comes and the oven boils over, load into it a pair of two of every kind, and your family—except those among them against whom the word has preceded. And do not address Me concerning those who did wrong; for indeed they are to be drowned.
23:28: When you and those with you are settled in the ship, say: Praise be to Allah, who has delivered us from the wrongdoing people.
23:29: And say: My Rabb, land me at a blessed landing place, for You are the best of those who land.
23:30: Undoubtedly in this are signs, and indeed We are truly testers.
23:31: Then after them We produced another generation.
23:32: We sent to them a messenger from among them: Worship Allah, you have no deity other than Him, will you not still beware? he said.
23:33: And the notables from his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter—to whom We gave luxury in the life of this world—said: This is none other than a human being like you; he eats of what you eat and drinks of what you drink.
23:34: And if you obey a human being like yourselves, then undoubtedly you are surely losers.
23:35: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones, you will be brought forth?
23:36: Far off, far off is that which you are threatened with.
23:37: It is only our life of this world; we die and we live, and we will not be resurrected.
23:38: He is only a man who has invented a lie against Allah, and we are not believers in him.
23:39: He said: My Rabb, help me because they have denied me.
23:40: He said: In a little while they will surely become regretful.
23:41: So the blast seized them in truth, and We made them rubbish. Away with the wrongdoing people.
23:42: Then after them We brought into being other generations.
23:43: No community can advance its appointed term, nor can they postpone it.
23:44: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time its messenger came to a community, they denied him. So We made them follow one after another, and We made them tales. Away with a people who do not believe.
23:45: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority.
23:46: To Pharaoh and his notables, but they showed arrogance and were an exalted people.
23:47: They said: Shall we believe in two human beings like ourselves while their people are slaves to us?
23:48: So they denied them and became of those who were destroyed.
23:49: And by oath, We gave Moses the Book so that they might find the right way.
23:50: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and We sheltered them at a high place suitable for dwelling, having a spring.
23:51: O messengers, eat of the good things and do righteous deeds. Undoubtedly I am knowing of what you do.
23:52: And undoubtedly this community of yours is a single community, and I am your Rabb, so fear Me.
23:53: But they tore their affair into pieces among themselves, each group rejoicing in what they have.
23:54: So leave them in their bewilderment for a time.
23:55: Do they think that which We extend to them of wealth and children,
23:56: We hasten for them in good things? No, they do not perceive.
23:57: Undoubtedly, they are those who tremble with the fear of their Rabb.
23:58: And they believe in the signs of their Rabb.
23:59: And they do not associate partners with their Rabb.
23:60: And they who give what they give while their hearts tremble with fear because they will return to their Rabb.
23:61: It is they who hasten in good deeds, and they are foremost in them.
23:62: And We do not burden any soul except according to its capacity. With Us is a Book that speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged.
23:63: Rather, their hearts are in bewilderment because of this, and they have deeds besides this which they perform.
23:64: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, they at once cry out for help.
23:65: Do not cry out for help today; undoubtedly you will not receive help from Us.
23:66: Truly My signs were being recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels.
23:67: Showing arrogance against it, raving in delirious talk by night, turning away.
23:68: Did they not ponder the Word, or did there come to them that which had not come to their earlier forefathers?
23:69: Or did they not recognize their messenger, so that they are deniers of him?
23:70: Or do they say, 'In him is madness'? No, he came to them with the truth, and most of them are haters of the truth.
23:71: If the truth had followed their desires, the heavens, the earth, and whoever is in them would surely have been corrupted. Rather, We brought them their dhikr, yet they turn away from their dhikr.
23:72: Or are you asking them for a payment? The reward of your Rabb is better, and He is the best of providers.
23:73: And surely you call them to a straight path.
23:74: And surely those who do not believe in the Hereafter are certainly deviating from the path.
23:75: If We had mercy upon them and removed the harm that was upon them, they would have persisted wandering blindly in their transgression.
23:76: And indeed, We had seized them with punishment, yet they did not humble themselves to their Rabb, nor did they supplicate.
23:77: Until when We opened upon them the gate of severe punishment, they were suddenly despairing therein.
23:78: And He is the One who created for you hearing, sight, and hearts; how little you give thanks.
23:79: And He is the One who created and scattered you on the earth, and unto Him you will be gathered.
23:80: He is the One who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of the night and the day; will you not still reason?
23:81: No, rather they say like what the former ones said.
23:82: They said: 'When we are dead and have become dust and bones, will we really be resurrected?'
23:83: Indeed, this was promised to us and to our forefathers before. This is nothing but legends of the ancients.
23:84: Say: 'Whose is the earth and whoever is in it, if you know?'
23:85: They will say, 'Allah\'s.' Say, 'Then will you not take heed?'
23:86: Say: 'Who is the Rabb of the seven heavens and the Rabb of the Great Arsh?'
23:87: They will say, 'For Allah.' Say: 'Then will you not beware?'
23:88: Say: 'Who is it in whose hand is the dominion of all things? He protects, but none can be protected against Him, if you know?'
23:89: They say, 'For Allah.' Say: 'Then from where are you bewitched?'
23:90: Rather, We came to them with the truth, and surely they are liars.
23:91: Allah has not taken a child, nor is there any deity with Him; in that case, each deity would have taken away what he created, and some of them would have overcome others.
23:92: He is the Knower of the unseen and the seen; He is exalted above what they associate (with Him).
23:93: Say: 'My Rabb! If You should surely show me what they are promised,'
23:94: My Rabb, do not place me among the wrongdoing people.
23:95: And surely We are certainly able to show you that which We promised them.
23:96: Repel evil with that which is best; We know better what they describe.
23:97: And say: 'My Rabb! I seek refuge in You from the proddings of the devils.'
23:98: And my Rabb, I seek refuge in You lest they be present with me.
23:99: Until when death comes to one of them, he says: 'My Rabb, send me back!'
23:100: So that I may do righteous deeds in that which I left behind. No, never! Surely it is a word that he speaks. And behind them is a barzakh until the Day they are resurrected.
23:101: When the Trumpet is blown, there will be no lineage among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
23:102: Whose scales are heavy, those are the ones who are successful.
23:103: Whose scales are light, those are the ones who have ruined themselves, abiding eternally in Hell.
23:104: The Fire licks their faces, and they remain therein with their teeth bared.
23:105: Were My verses not recited to you, and you used to deny them?
23:106: They say: 'Our Rabb, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people gone astray.'
23:107: Our Rabb, if You bring us out of it, then if we return (to evil), surely we will be wrongdoers.
23:108: He said: 'Be humiliated therein, and do not speak to Me!'
23:109: Indeed, there was a group of My servants who used to say: 'Our Rabb, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
23:110: You took them as a subject of mockery until they made you forget My dhikr, and you were laughing at them.
23:111: Indeed, I have rewarded them today for what they endured patiently; they are the ones who are successful.
23:112: He said: 'How long did you remain in the earth, by number of years?'
23:113: They said: 'We remained a day or part of a day; so ask those who know the numbers.'
23:114: He says: 'You remained but a little time, if only you had known.'
23:115: Did you think that We created you in vain and that you would not be returned to Us?
23:116: Exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign; there is no deity except Him, He is the Rabb of the Noble Arsh.
23:117: Whoever calls upon another deity along with Allah, he has no proof thereof; indeed, his account is with his Rabb. Surely the disbelievers will not succeed.
23:118: And say: 'My Rabb, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.'
